title: Filtered graded cycles present the canonical tower pages
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and let U=(K,F) be a finite filtered integer-indexed cochain complex [def-sp-filtration]. For every such V and integers p,q,r with r>=1, suppose hBZ gives B_r^(p,q)(V)<=Z_r^(p,q)(V), with the graded cycle and boundary subobjects of [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Suppose eH identifies coker(B_1->Z_1) with H^(p+q)(gr^p V). Assume eH is normalized as follows: there are maps z from the first cycle representatives to Z_1 and g from those representatives to the graded cycles, both inducing the graded quotient of the representative inclusion, with z epic and z pi eH=g pi_H. Let X be the concrete homology exact couple of (K,F) [def-sp-filtered-homology-exact-couple], with its canonical cycle-boundary tower T [def-sp-convergence] and initial equality isomorphism e0:X.E(2p+q,-p)->H^(p+q)(gr^p K). Write j_s^(p,q):Z_(s+1)^(p,q)->cycles(gr^p K,p+q) and t_s^(p,q):Z_(s+1)^(p,q)->T.Z(s,2p+q,-p). Their normalization equations are j_s iCycles=the graded cycle-subobject inclusion and t_s T.Z.arrow e0=j_s pi_H. There exist families j,t satisfying these equations for all natural s and integers p,q. The composite Q_s=t_s T.projection(s,2p+q,-p) is epic and kernelSubobject(Q_s)=imageSubobject(B_(s+1)^(p,q)->Z_(s+1)^(p,q)), where this inclusion is supplied by hBZ. No page isomorphism or differential compatibility is asserted.

proof.text: Factor every graded cycle inclusion through graded cycles. Monotonicity of filtered cycles reduces the square-zero condition to the first-page kernel formula. This defines the normalized j family uniquely. After the normalized t family is constructed, use hH and epic cancellation to identify the stage-zero composite with pi followed by eH and the inverse initial E isomorphism. Cokernel exactness gives the epic quotient and its boundary kernel.

Construct all t before the quotient induction. Identify alphaIter with homology of filtration inclusions, and initial f with the connecting morphism. The connecting-morphism representative formula sends an (s+1)-cycle representative to its differential in F^(p+s+1). The differential is a cycle because d squared vanishes. Its homology class, followed by the incoming alpha inclusion, represents the initial connecting class. Thus the initial E class factors through the finite-cycle-formula pullback on an epic cycle-representative cover. Invariance of image under epic precomposition gives the same factorization on the graded cycle subobject itself. Factor through the monic canonical tower inclusion to obtain t and its normalization at every stage.

Induct on the epic quotient and boundary kernel assertions only. At stage s their cokernel universal property supplies normalized isomorphisms to concrete quotient pages. Choose the uniquely normalized representative differential. The tower differential formula on an epic representative cover identifies both incoming and outgoing differentials after reindexing. Kernel and cokernel universal properties transport the canonical derived E quotient to the homology of this concrete page. Use filteredComplex_normalized_homology, which already packages the successor-cycle cover and successor-boundary image, to identify that homology with the successor quotient, normalized on successor cycles. Monic normalization of j and t identifies their transition maps. The canonical cycleLift_comm and projection_succ equations then identify the successor Q followed by this isomorphism with the concrete cokernel projection. Epimorphy and the boundary kernel follow from this equation and cokernel exactness.

theorem filteredHomology_tower_quotients
    (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (hBZ : ∀ (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
          (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite))
      (p q r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
      U.obj.filtration.complexBoundaries p (p + q) r ≤
        U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) r)
    (eH : ∀ (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
          (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite)) (p q : ℤ),
      cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (hBZ U p q 1 (by omega))) ≅
        (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).homology (p + q))
    (hH : ∀ (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
          (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite)) (p q : ℤ),
      ∃ (z : (U.obj.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) 1 : C) ⟶
          (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) 1 : C))
        (g : (U.obj.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) 1 : C) ⟶
          (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).cycles (p + q)),
        z ≫ (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) 1).arrow =
          (U.obj.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) 1).arrow ≫
            (U.obj.filtration.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f (p + q) ∧
        g ≫ (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).iCycles (p + q) =
          (U.obj.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) 1).arrow ≫
            (U.obj.filtration.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f (p + q) ∧
        Epi z ∧
        z ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (hBZ U p q 1 (by omega))) ≫
            (eH U p q).hom =
          g ≫ (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).homologyπ (p + q))
    (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
          (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite))
 :
    ∃ (j : ∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1) : C) ⟶
        (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).cycles (p + q))
      (t : ∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1) : C) ⟶
        ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).cycleBoundaryTower.Z
          s (2 * p + q) (-p) : C)),
      (∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      j s p q ≫ (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).iCycles (p + q) =
        (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1)).arrow) ∧
      (∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      t s p q ≫
          ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).cycleBoundaryTower.Z
            s (2 * p + q) (-p)).arrow ≫
          (filteredHomologyEIso U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration p q).hom =
        j s p q ≫ (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).homologyπ (p + q)) ∧
      (∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), Epi (t s p q ≫
          (filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).cycleBoundaryTower.projection
            s (2 * p + q) (-p))) ∧
      (∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), kernelSubobject (t s p q ≫
          (filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).cycleBoundaryTower.projection
            s (2 * p + q) (-p)) =
        imageSubobject (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (hBZ U p q (s + 1) (by omega))))
